svg.text: Any angle. The geometry is read along the symbol's own lines, never along image rows.
A finder reads 1:1:3:1:1 along any line through its centre, so the row scan meets it at any
The longest side of the centres' triangle is still the diagonal, so the corner does not depend
Module sizes are measured along the finder lines. An image row cuts a turned ring on the slant
and reads it up to √2 too long.
The transform carries the turn into the grid; sampling is the same as upright.
A mirrored capture has the same finders and a transposed grid: a grid that does not read is
Every pass runs this path: the global positive, the global negative, then the regional passes (see the shared passes).
